name: v277_news12_benchmark_reversal_slow
hypothesis: Large post-news outperformance versus SPY can reflect short-horizon overreaction; a slow, large-cap industry-ranked reversal may capture event digestion without using the occupied news18 earnings surfaces.

name: v277_news12_short_interest_pressure
hypothesis: High short-interest ratio around news events can indicate informed negative pressure; smoothing it should avoid raw event-path turnover.

name: v277_news12_path_asymmetry_two_pct
hypothesis: When downside thresholds are reached faster than upside thresholds after news, the event path may reveal persistent adverse information rather than generic sentiment.

name: v277_total_asset_estimate_visibility
hypothesis: Low dispersion in analyst total-asset estimates may proxy balance-sheet visibility and lower hidden asset-risk, distinct from ordinary debt or EBIT delivery.

name: v277_total_asset_delivery_error
hypothesis: Companies whose reported total assets land close to analyst expectations may have cleaner disclosure and fewer balance-sheet surprises.

name: v277_gross_income_visibility
hypothesis: Consensus gross-income strength with low dispersion may capture cost pass-through visibility before it reaches crowded EPS or EBIT estimates.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_median / abs(assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_std / abs(assets), 126), industry), -1)
